en: A colored vintage postcard view of a European city square lined with multi‑story historic buildings and red-tiled roofs. In the foreground is a busy public square with market stalls, people walking, a central monument/statue on a pedestal, and a tram. In the background, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower and fortification. The style is early 20th-century. At the top left is printed text reading "Graz. Hauptplatz." Various shop signs are visible on the buildings around the square.
